groups.sentence: Instructors may permit AI only for specific tasks or assignments and clearly state those limits.
Users must get prior approval or review from the relevant university body before using certain AI tools or data.
Students must consult their advisor, committee chair or faculty mentor and get approval before using AI in research or thesis work.
Instructors must approve AI use before it is allowed in their classes.
Students get instructor permission before using AI for coursework, and discuss in advance how and why they plan to use it.
Students may use AI only for specific tasks or assignments that the instructor has authorized or listed.
Students must explain or submit, in writing, how they plan to use AI before using it.
Students must not use AI beyond the listed purposes or without authorization.
Staff and faculty must consult a supervisor, administrator or chair before using AI, including non-approved tools.
TAs and staff must not use AI without the course instructor's authorization and use it only for listed tasks.
Students are prohibited from using generative AI in all coursework.
Instructors approve AI use based on how appropriate it is and its educational value.
AI use in the course will be limited and specific.
